name: h743-Release

manual_findings.handle_initialization_and_parent_links: Reviewed concrete CubeMX global handles, startup BSS interval, MX/MSP initialization and reciprocal __HAL_LINKDMA parent links; see review document.
manual_findings.callback_installers_and_alias_writes: Reviewed typed HAL installers and source references, including dot assignments, macro aliases and whole-object copies; union of actual linked constant callbacks retained.
manual_findings.object_type_at_each_linked_load: Reviewed DMA handler parameter and UART parameter/hdmarx child at actual indirect loads; sealed compiler output and actual DWARF/reaching definitions checked.
manual_findings.null_only_field_initialization: Reviewed actual BSS initialization and absence of linked non-NULL installers for M1 and H7 DMA-only UART fields; unrelated NULL writes alone are not evidence.
manual_findings.no_runtime_registration: Reviewed disabled UART registration and absent/unreferenced DMA registration APIs; no selected application runtime callback registry or handle replacement.

review_basis: Manually reviewed A source/object/CRT/RTOS/HAL/IRQ closure plus actual Flight control reachability; independent normal B rebuild required for delivery acceptance.
